q1.explanationZh: extreme 形容词“极端的”，名词“极端”；副词是 extremely。

q2.explanationZh: extreme 加 -ly 构成副词 extremely“极其”。

q3.explanationZh: eye 名词“眼睛”，open up one’s eyes“开阔眼界”。

q4.explanationZh: eye + brow 构成合成词 eyebrow“眉毛”。

q5.explanationZh: eye + sight（视力）构成合成词 eyesight“视力”。

q6.explanationZh: fable 名词“寓言”，如 Aesop’s Fables《伊索寓言》。

q8.explanationZh: face 名词“脸”，动词“面对；面临”，be faced with“面临”。

q9.explanationZh: facilitate 及物动词“促进；使便利”，注意拼写 fa-ci-li-tate。

q10.explanationZh: facility“便利”，表示“设备，设施”时常用复数 facilities。

q11.explanationZh: fact 名词“事实”，in fact“事实上”。

q12.explanationZh: factor 名词“因素”，a key factor“关键因素”。

q13.explanationZh: factory 名词“工厂”，复数 factories。

q14.explanationZh: fade 动词“褪色；凋谢”，也可表示声音、记忆等逐渐消失。

q15.explanationZh: fail 动词“失败；不及格”，fail to do sth.“没能做某事”；名词是 failure。

q16.explanationZh: fail 加 -ure 构成名词 failure“失败”。

q17.explanationZh: faint 形容词“微弱的”，动词和名词“昏厥”。

q18.explanationZh: fair 形容词“公平的”，名词“集市；博览会”，如 a book fair“书展”。

q19.explanationZh: fair 加 -ly 构成副词 fairly“相当；公正地”。

q20.explanationZh: fairy 名词“小精灵；仙子”，fairy tale“童话故事”。

q21.explanationZh: faith 名词“信心；信念”，形容词 faithful“忠实的”。

q22.explanationZh: fake 可作动词“伪造”、名词“假货”和形容词“假的”。

q23.explanationZh: fall 动词、名词“落下；跌倒”，美式英语中名词还表示“秋天”；过去式 fell。

q24.explanationZh: false 形容词“不正确的；不真实的”，反义词是 true。

q25.explanationZh: fame 名词“名声”，形容词是 famous。

q26.explanationZh: familiar 形容词“熟悉的”，be familiar with“熟悉……”。

q28.explanationZh: famous 形容词“著名的”，be famous for“因……而著名”。

q29.explanationZh: fan 有两个同形词：“风扇；扇”和“狂热爱好者；迷”，拼写相同。

q30.explanationZh: fancy 名词“想象力；爱好”，动词“想象；想要”，fancy doing sth.。

q31.explanationZh: fantastic 形容词“奇异的；了不起的”，名词是 fantasy。

q32.explanationZh: fantasy 名词“幻想”，形容词是 fantastic。

q33.explanationZh: far 形容词、副词“远的（地）”，比较级 farther/further，最高级 farthest/furthest。

q34.explanationZh: fare 名词“车费；票价”，注意与 fair 同音。

q35.explanationZh: fare + well 构成 farewell“告别（的）”，a farewell party“告别会”。

q37.explanationZh: face to face“面对面地”，常与 with 连用：face to face with sb.。

accept: make a face at (= pull a face at)

q38.explanationZh: “向……做鬼脸”= make a face at = pull a face at。

q39.explanationZh: on the face of it“从表面上来看”，it 不能省略。

q40.explanationZh: “保全面子”= save (one’s) face，one’s 可以省略。

q41.explanationZh: show one’s face“露面，到场”，one’s 随主语变化，如 show his face。

q42.explanationZh: “对……失去信心”= lose faith in，faith 是不可数名词，介词用 in。

q43.explanationZh: fail in“在……上失败，在……中不及格”，介词用 in。

q44.explanationZh: without fail“必定，务必”，这里 fail 是名词。

q47.explanationZh: fall off“跌落；减少”，如 fall off the shelf“从架子上掉下来”。

q48.explanationZh: be familiar with“对……熟悉”，主语是人。

q49.explanationZh: be familiar to sb.“为某人所熟悉”，主语是事物。

q50.explanationZh: as far as“远到……；就……而言”，如 as far as I know“据我所知”。

q51.explanationZh: a world of 后接名词，“冷热两个极端”用复数 extremes。

q52.explanationZh: face downwards“脸朝下”，作伴随状态。

q53.explanationZh: a recent 后接可数名词单数，“新近制作的赝品”用 fake。

q54.explanationZh: fairy tales“童话故事”，fairy 作定语。

q55.explanationZh: fail to do sth.“没能做某事”，与 tried 并列，用过去式 failed。

q56.explanationZh: have a fall“摔一跤”，a 后接名词单数 fall。

q58.explanationZh: sports facilities“体育设施”，表示设施时用复数 facilities。

q59.explanationZh: the fact that...“……这一事实”，that 引导同位语从句。

q60.explanationZh: set up a factory“建工厂”，a 后用单数 factory。

q61.sampleAnswer: We’ve decided to have a farewell party before we leave the school.
references: We’ve decided to have a farewell party before we leave the school.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “告别派对”= a farewell party，farewell 作形容词；“决定做某事”= decide to do sth.。

q62.sampleAnswer: In the face of injustice, he didn’t hesitate to stand up and defend justice.
references: In the face of injustice, he didn’t hesitate to stand up and defend justice.
Faced with injustice, he didn’t hesitate to step up and defend what is right.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “面对……”= in the face of 或 faced with（过去分词作状语）；“毫不犹豫地做”= not hesitate to do。

q63.sampleAnswer: According to the travel brochure/guide, the village is famous for its well-preserved minority culture.
references: According to the travel brochure/guide, the village is famous for its well-preserved minority culture.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “因……而闻名”= be famous for；“据……介绍”= according to。

q64.sampleAnswer: Do you fancy having a walk in the garden after supper?
references: Do you fancy having a walk in the garden after supper?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “想要做某事”= fancy doing sth.，fancy 后接动名词。

q65.sampleAnswer: I will take a holiday with my family as I finish all the exams.
references: I will take a holiday with my family as I finish all the exams.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “度假”= take a holiday；“与家人一起”= with my family。

q66.sampleAnswer: On International Mathematics Day, which falls on March 14th, the expert was invited to give a lecture on mathematical symbols to primary school students.
references: On International Mathematics Day, which falls on March 14th, the expert was invited to give a lecture on mathematical symbols to primary school students.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “（节日）在某天”= fall on，用非限制性定语从句；“受邀做某事”= be invited to do sth.。

q67.sampleAnswer: Nobody could really help you if you have lost faith in your own ability.
references: Nobody could really help you if you have lost faith in your own ability.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “对……失去信心”= lose faith in，用现在完成时 have lost。

q68.sampleAnswer: I think the reason for his failure to learn English well is that he lacks perseverance.
references: I think the reason for his failure to learn English well is that he lacks perseverance.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “没能做某事”可用名词 failure to do sth.；the reason for... is that...“……的原因是……”。

q69.sampleAnswer: When you learn grammar, it is far from enough only to understand what the teacher explains.
references: When you learn grammar, it is far from enough only to understand what the teacher explains.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “远远不够”= far from enough；it 作形式主语，真正的主语是 to understand...。

q70.sampleAnswer: Whether one can persevere in what he is doing is one of the important factors of his success.
references: Whether one can persevere in what he is doing is one of the important factors of his success.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “……之一”= one of + 复数名词 factors；whether 引导主语从句，谓语用单数 is。
